kit: FAST isometric kit: batch 1 (structural + terrain + neighbourhood) and batch 2 (room furniture, interactive objects and decorations, bed plants, the tree, garden decorations, six avatars, chickens; D-84 to D-86)
status: final art for the FYP (D-54, D-55); code-generated, declared in docs/ai_use_log.md. Batch-2 pieces are drafts ('approved': false) until Patrick approves the previews

grid.placement: draw at map_origin + ((gx-gy)*32, (gx+gy)*16) - footprint_origin, where (gx, gy) is the piece's back cell; ground tiles first, then the neighbourhood (behind the home plot), then the home plot's structures back-to-front by gx+gy
